linesVerbatim: ## Proposed independent-release trust
Component/index/core/repair trust needs explicit, separate roles and recovery:
- core, index, component, offline bundle, and repair-media signatures;
- delegated publisher/component namespaces and threshold policy;
- SBOM and attestation digests inside the signed closure;
- last-known revocation and metadata expiry for air-gapped/removable media;
- root recovery, quorum loss, emergency running-component, and break-glass;
- monotonic trust/revocation/anti-rollback state that executable rollback cannot
reverse; and
- clean-machine no-network verification tests.
These are readiness blockers DR-103 and DR-112, not claimed settled mechanisms.

offlineTextCarriedVerbatim.note: Not in the file 08 source-pin cell. Load-bearing. DR-202 F4 routes the newly-revoked replay case here to be named and deferred.
linesVerbatim: ## Offline update, trust, and repair
No-network clean-machine use is a first-class test. Air-gap/removable-media input
must carry the root chain, signed index snapshot, last-known revocation state,
expiry information, manifests, payloads, permissions, and repair material. The
policy must define expired metadata, stale last-known revocation, clock limits,
quorum loss, newly revoked running/replay components, and core/index/component/
repair trust separately.
No missing payload triggers download, refresh, or lock mutation. Expired or
future metadata cannot be partially understood. Current verified components may
continue only under the reviewed offline-running policy. DR-112 and DR-G06/G08
are hard blockers.

states.means: No accepted root/index snapshot for this role.
Current signed snapshot for this role verifies at the byte level (DR-103) and is inside expiry and last-known-revocation floors.
Metadata expiry floor elapsed. Not partially readable.
Last-known revocation is older than the reserved freshness floor.
Observed signer set is below the reserved threshold. No new admission.
This role's current snapshot or namespace is revoked by a newer accepted revocation observation.
Root-recovery ceremony in progress. No new admission except the recovery payload.

events.means: An air-gap or removable-media payload is presented. Never an implicit network fetch.
A host clock observation is recorded. Clock authority is this row's; untrustworthy clock cannot silently extend expiry.
A newer revocation observation is presented and byte-verifies.
Signer-set cardinality is observed against the reserved threshold.
Recovery ceremony starts under the named procedure.
Recovery publishes new roots. Anti-rollback counter advances. Executables do not move this counter backward.
Admit or refresh install-scoped bytes for this role.
Ask whether a currently verified installed component may keep running.
Operator or failed-ceremony abort of an in-progress recovery. Audited. Does not publish a new root. Does not restore prior TRUSTED by silence.

transitions.guard: Payload kind MUST be ordinary (airGapPayload.payloadKind). TRUSTED-entry is INACTIVE until ID-DEP-1 and envelopePreimageJoin activate; while INACTIVE this transition refuses fail-closed (CODEX-V2-B2). Once ACTIVE: Payload complete; DR-103 UNSIGNED/DIGEST_MISMATCH pass; trustPolicyShape requiredOnEveryTrustedEntry all hold (envelope check INACTIVE until ID-DEP-1+ceremony). Else stay UNBOOTSTRAPPED and refuse.

Payload kind MUST be ordinary (airGapPayload.payloadKind). TRUSTED-entry is INACTIVE until ID-DEP-1 and envelopePreimageJoin activate; while INACTIVE this transition refuses fail-closed (CODEX-V2-B2). Once ACTIVE: Newer consistent snapshot; DR-103 byte-level pass; trustPolicyShape requiredOnEveryTrustedEntry all hold; anti-rollback refuses a strictly older snapshot. Else stay TRUSTED and refuse the payload. Never fetch.

Payload kind MUST be ordinary (airGapPayload.payloadKind). TRUSTED-entry is INACTIVE until ID-DEP-1 and envelopePreimageJoin activate; while INACTIVE this transition refuses fail-closed (CODEX-V2-B2). Once ACTIVE: Ordinary air-gap refresh, not recovery. Same TRUSTED-entry predicate as first-bootstrap. Heals the prior condition. ST-REVOKED is not this member.
TRUSTED-entry must be ACTIVE. Admit or refresh only while TRUSTED and trustPolicyShape still holds. Outcome: accepted install.
Refuse new install/admission. Audited refusal. Not a wildcard 'same or refuse'.
See offlineRunningPolicy.totalDecision. Never mutates lock bytes. Always audited. Refusal reasons are the CONTINUE-* vocabulary on that table.

Payload kind MUST be recovery. Stages ceremony inputs and is ACCEPTED without changing state, including from ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED. It does not skip EV-RECOVER-BEGIN. It does not enter ST-TRUSTED. Ordinary payload is the separate TRUSTED-entry members.
Observed time >= metadataExpiry. If stale-revocation also holds, visible state is ST-EXPIRED by statePrecedence; stale breach is audited.
Revocation older than reserved freshness floor AND EXPIRED guard does not hold.
Observed time >= metadataExpiry. Promotes ST-STALE-REVOCATION to ST-EXPIRED (CLAUDE-V2-S1 / CODEX-V2-B1 precedence). Concurrent stale remains audited.
ACCEPT the clock observation. Ceremony is not EV-CLOCK-preempted. Concurrent expiry/stale is audited.

Newer byte-valid revocation observation. ACCEPT. Advance monotonic last-known revocation. From ST-REVOKED this is stay-and-ACCEPT, not default refuse (CODEX-V2-B1 monotonic revoke). Safety-dominant over expiry/staleness/recovery.
Observed signers < reserved threshold AND REVOKED does not also hold. If both, the EV-REVOKE rank wins and this guard is false.
ACCEPT the observation. Still-below stays. Restored quorum also stays: leaving ST-QUORUM-LOST requires an ordinary payload refresh, not this event.
ACCEPT the observation. Quorum breach is audited. Visible state stays ST-REVOKED by precedence.
Ceremony inputs are present (staged by recovery-typed EV-PRESENT-PAYLOAD or presented with this event). Else fallback RECOVERY-BEGIN-REFUSED.

TRUSTED-entry ACTIVE. recoveryTrustedEntry all hold. DR-103 active byte-level checks plus DR-112 envelope verification after ID-DEP-1 activation (envelope is not a DR-103 subcode). Counters advance. Executables do not roll counters back. Else stay RECOVERY and refuse.

whenActiveFailure.predicate: TRUSTED-entry is ACTIVE and a recoveryTrustedEntry conjunct other than envelope standing fails

transitions.guard: ACCEPT the abort event (audit outcome=accepted; refusalReason FORBIDDEN on this event record). A separate ceremonyTermination record {from: ST-RECOVERY, to: toFunction result, reason: RECOVERY-ABORTED} is appended. toFunction selects the first still-true candidateInOrder, else ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED. Never ST-TRUSTED. Never publishes a root.
Payload kind MUST be recovery. Does not skip EV-RECOVER-COMMIT. Invalid payload: stay RECOVERY and refuse (abort is EV-RECOVER-ABORT, not this failure). This is the sole ST-RECOVERY/PRESENT member.

failClosed: No missing payload triggers download, refresh, or lock mutation.
Expired or future metadata cannot be partially understood.

A role in any non-TRUSTED state cannot admit new bytes for that role.
machine.defaultTransition: Apply outcomeBranchDiscipline, including memberApplicability, first on every transitions[] member that names the (state, event) pair. If an applicable named member yields a true outcome branch (or, for an applicable branchless member, a true guard), that member fires. If no applicable named member yields a true branch or true branchless guard, apply fallbackByEvent[event] (or fallbackDefault if the event is absent). Fallback therefore covers unnamed pairs, inapplicable named members, AND applicable named pairs whose branches/guards are all false. It is not reachable for a named whenInactive case on an applicable member.
machine.statePrecedence: When two declared transitions share a (state, event) pair, and when encoding which refuse-condition label is visible, the safety-dominant rank is ST-REVOKED > ST-QUORUM-LOST > ST-EXPIRED > ST-STALE-REVOCATION > ST-RECOVERY > ST-TRUSTED > ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED. Concurrent lesser breaches are recorded on the audit record. That ranking is implemented by named transitions (not by a side-channel that overrides defaultTransition). ST-RECOVERY is deliberately not EV-CLOCK-preempted: a ceremony underway because predecessor metadata expired or went stale must survive those predecessor conditions. EV-REVOKE, EV-QUORUM-OBSERVE (below threshold), and EV-RECOVER-ABORT still leave RECOVERY because those are named transitions.

EV-CLOCK.note: Ordinary no-change clock observation (still fresh, still not stale, or already at a rank that clock does not promote). ACCEPTED stay.

EV-REVOKE.note: From ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED, or a revocation that is not newer/byte-valid. REFUSE stay. Newer valid revoke is a named transition, including from ST-REVOKED.

EV-QUORUM-OBSERVE.note: Ordinary observation that does not change rank (still at/above threshold, or already at a dominant rank whose named transition recorded the observation). ACCEPTED stay.

EV-PRESENT-PAYLOAD.note: Invalid or incomplete payload, or recovery-typed payload that does not match a staging/recovery PRESENT member. Not-yet-active TRUSTED-entry on a named PRESENT->TRUSTED member is OUT OF SCOPE (normativeExclusion); it uses whenInactive ENVELOPE-INACTIVE.
EV-PRESENT-PAYLOAD.normativeExclusion: OUT OF SCOPE for INACTIVE TRUSTED-entry on a named PRESENT->TRUSTED member. outcomeBranchDiscipline selects whenInactive ENVELOPE-INACTIVE. This fallback MUST NOT supply the reason.

EV-INSTALL.note: New admission only from ST-TRUSTED while TRUSTED-entry is ACTIVE. INACTIVE on the named TRUSTED+INSTALL member is OUT OF SCOPE (normativeExclusion); it uses whenInactive ENVELOPE-INACTIVE.
EV-INSTALL.normativeExclusion: OUT OF SCOPE for INACTIVE TRUSTED-entry on the named ST-TRUSTED+EV-INSTALL member. outcomeBranchDiscipline selects whenInactive ENVELOPE-INACTIVE. This fallback MUST NOT supply the reason.

EV-RECOVER-BEGIN.note: Ceremony inputs absent or role not in an allowed source state.

EV-RECOVER-COMMIT.note: Not in ST-RECOVERY, or no named member yielded a branch. TRUSTED-entry still INACTIVE on the named RECOVER-COMMIT member is OUT OF SCOPE (normativeExclusion). ACTIVE recoveryTrustedEntry failure other than envelope standing is the named whenActiveFailure.
EV-RECOVER-COMMIT.normativeExclusion: OUT OF SCOPE for INACTIVE TRUSTED-entry on the named ST-RECOVERY+EV-RECOVER-COMMIT member. outcomeBranchDiscipline selects whenInactive ENVELOPE-INACTIVE. This fallback MUST NOT supply the reason. ACTIVE-but-other-conjunct-failed uses the member's whenActiveFailure RECOVERY-COMMIT-REFUSED, not a second reading of this fallback.

EV-RECOVER-ABORT.note: Abort is only defined from ST-RECOVERY.

EV-CONTINUE.note: Only reached if totalDecision/defaultRefuse failed to classify; should not happen. Never mutates lock bytes.

machine.recoveryTrustedEntry: Required on EV-RECOVER-COMMIT. Equals requiredOnEveryTrustedEntry except bootstrapAnchorCustody is replaced by recoveryAuthorityShape.requiredOnRecoverCommit in full (positive authorization, reserved threshold, old-root/new-root/role binding, newRootDoesNotSelfAuthorize). DR-103 active byte-level checks (UNSIGNED/DIGEST_MISMATCH) plus DR-112 envelope verification after ID-DEP-1 activation. roleToKeyAndDelegatedNamespace, expiryAndFutureTime, revocationFreshness, and antiRollback still apply. TRUSTED-entry ACTIVE is necessary and not sufficient.

outcomeBranchDiscipline.standing: NORMATIVE. Selects the outcome of a named transitions[] member before defaultTransition fallback.
outcomeBranchDiscipline.appliesTo: Any transitions[] member that names the (state, event) pair, declares one or more of whenInactive / whenActiveFailure / whenActiveSuccess, AND whose applicability preconditions hold. Applicability includes authenticated payloadKind (ordinary vs recovery) and any other guard clause that selects this member rather than a sibling member of the same pair. A member excluded by kind (or another selecting precondition) yields NO branch and does not compete.
outcomeBranchDiscipline.branchlessMembers: A member with none of those objects is evaluated by its guard alone: true guard fires the member; false guard does not. If every named member for the pair is branchless and false-guarded, or the pair is unnamed, fallbackByEvent applies.
evaluationOrder: memberApplicability — if false, this member yields no branch.
whenInactive — true iff the member is applicable AND this member's TRUSTED-entry / envelope standing is INACTIVE. Outcome is the whenInactive object. Never the event fallback.
whenActiveFailure — true iff the member is applicable AND TRUSTED-entry is ACTIVE and a required conjunct other than envelope standing fails.
whenActiveSuccess — true iff the member is applicable AND TRUSTED-entry is ACTIVE and the remaining member guard holds.
outcomeBranchDiscipline.mutualExclusion: At most one branch is true. whenInactive and either ACTIVE branch cannot both hold. whenActiveFailure and whenActiveSuccess cannot both hold.
outcomeBranchDiscipline.beforeFallback: The first true branch on an applicable member is the member outcome. fallbackByEvent is reached only when no applicable named member exists, or no applicable named member yields a true branch (or true branchless guard). A named INACTIVE case on an applicable ordinary-payload member therefore cannot emit PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE, INSTALL-NOT-TRUSTED, or RECOVERY-COMMIT-REFUSED. A recovery-typed PRESENT while INACTIVE is staged by the applicable recovery member (or PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE if no recovery member applies); it is not ENVELOPE-INACTIVE on an ordinary member.
outcomeBranchDiscipline.notesAreNotTheRule: fallbackByEvent[].note and fallbackByEvent[].normativeExclusion restate this rule; outcomeBranchDiscipline is the algorithm.
outcomeBranchDiscipline.memberApplicability: NORMATIVE. Evaluate the member's selecting preconditions BEFORE any outcome branch. For EV-PRESENT-PAYLOAD, payloadKind MUST match the member (ordinary members 0-2; recovery staging member 6). A recovery-typed payload never makes an ordinary member's whenInactive true. A member that fails applicability is treated as if it were not named for this evaluation.

offlineRunningPolicy.scope: Currently verified installed components on install surfaces (G08). Not repair-media. Not replay.
offlineRunningPolicy.alreadyRunningVsNewProcess: already-running continuation is distinct from starting a new process. New process requires the same decision as EV-INSTALL (TRUSTED only).
offlineRunningPolicy.precedence: Evaluate CORE first, then INDEX, then COMPONENT. First fail-closed hit wins. Unnamed combination = refuse both continuation and new start.

offlineRunningPolicy.defaultRefuse: Any combination not matched after precedence: refuse already-running continuation and new process with refusalReason CONTINUE-UNMATCHED-COMBINATION. Do not treat process survival as trust.

payloadKind.standing: AUTHENTICATED discriminator in the payload shape, not a presenter-supplied label.
payloadKind.rule: ordinary payloads may take TRUSTED-entry transitions once ACTIVE. recovery payloads may only stage (no state change) from EXPIRED/STALE/QUORUM-LOST/REVOKED/UNBOOTSTRAPPED, or remain in ST-RECOVERY. A recovery payload NEVER enters ST-TRUSTED via EV-PRESENT-PAYLOAD. Kind is part of the declared payload preimage; a presenter cannot relabel it.

shape: Identify the role being recovered (never a collapsed 'trust').
Present the recovery payload on air-gap/removable media (EV-PRESENT-PAYLOAD + EV-RECOVER-BEGIN).

Byte-verify with DR-103 active subcodes only. Ceremony validity (key, threshold, expiry of the recovery envelope, and recoveryAuthorityShape) is this row; numbers are reserved. bootstrapAnchorCustody is not applied to a replacement root.
Advance anti-rollback / last-known revocation. Do not move executable pointers as a side effect of recovery.
Record an audit event (role, from-state, to-state, payload digests, clock observation).
EV-RECOVER-COMMIT only after those records exist.
recoveryCeremony.doesNotMint: Quorum size, participant list, break-glass officer, or waiver duration.

auditAndWaiver.audit: Every ATTEMPTED event — including guard failure and fallback — appends { role, from, to, event, outcome: accepted|refused, refusalReason?, payloadDigests, clockObservation }. Stay-and-refuse records to == from. refusalReason is REQUIRED exactly when outcome=refused, drawn from refusalReasonVocabulary, and FORBIDDEN when outcome=accepted. EV-RECOVER-ABORT is accepted; its ceremony end is a separate ceremonyTermination record, not a refusalReason on the accepted event. This is operational metadata as the live DR-124 row names that class. It is not sealed evidence. Negative fixtures must assert the expected refusalReason on refused events and its absence on accepted events.
auditAndWaiver.waiverExpiry: Gate-waiver duration is product/release authority per the file 08 gate preamble. This artifact requires that any waiver of G08 carry an expiry and an audit record. It does not mint the duration.
auditAndWaiver.ceremonyTermination: Only for EV-RECOVER-ABORT: { role, from: ST-RECOVERY, to: toFunction result (declared meta-target same-or-named), reason: RECOVERY-ABORTED, payloadDigests }. Joined to the accepted abort event. RECOVERY-ABORTED is not a refusalReason on the event audit. to is never the undeclared token computed.

fixtureClasses.requires: A complete air-gap payload for TR-INDEX + TR-COMPONENT that reaches ST-TRUSTED with no network.
Any omitted mustCarry member refuses; the run log shows zero downloads, zero refresh, zero lock mutation.
Expired metadata refuses partial understand; role enters ST-EXPIRED.
Observed signers below reserved threshold enter ST-QUORUM-LOST. The fixture names the reserved knob; it does not invent the number as decided.

Recovery-typed payload from UNBOOTSTRAPPED/EXPIRED/STALE/QUORUM/REVOKED stages only (never ST-TRUSTED via PRESENT). EV-RECOVER-BEGIN -> ST-RECOVERY -> EV-RECOVER-COMMIT -> ST-TRUSTED only when recoveryTrustedEntry holds; EV-RECOVER-ABORT accepted with separate ceremonyTermination; counters advance only on commit.
Offline-running: expired index + trusted component continues already-installed process and refuses new admission.
Newly revoked REPLAY component: typed fail-closed refusal with refusalReason CONTINUE-REPLAY-NOT-DESIGNED; rides DR-113. Not an executable continue. Not an undesigned hole.
A named deferred vector for repair-media. Expected: rides DR-110. Not an executable G08 case.

While TRUSTED-entry is INACTIVE, forged-envelope and otherwise well-formed payloads refuse TRUSTED entry (fail-closed). After activation: wrong-key, revoked-namespace, threshold-failure, stale-bootstrap, future-bootstrap, and envelope-mismatch refuse. Unauthorized replacement-root commit refuses.

Evaluate all 7x7x7=343 (CORE, INDEX, COMPONENT) triples against totalDecision plus defaultRefuse. Required named cases: CORE revoked + INDEX expired + COMPONENT trusted refuses (CORE wins); all-TRUSTED continues; INDEX expired + COMPONENT trusted + CORE trusted continues already-running only; CORE expired + INDEX trusted + COMPONENT trusted refuses; CORE stale + INDEX trusted + COMPONENT trusted refuses; CORE trusted + INDEX UNBOOTSTRAPPED + COMPONENT trusted refuses.

Every refused named transition, fallback, and continuation refuse emits outcome=refused, to==from, and a refusalReason from refusalReasonVocabulary. Accepted events including EV-RECOVER-ABORT omit refusalReason. Named cases: non-TRUSTED EV-INSTALL => INSTALL-NOT-TRUSTED; CORE expired continuation => CONTINUE-CORE-NOT-TRUSTED.

TRUSTED then CLOCK (expiry+stale both true) yields ST-EXPIRED with stale audited; TRUSTED then CLOCK (stale only) then CLOCK (expiry now elapsed) yields ST-EXPIRED; ST-RECOVERY then EV-CLOCK stays RECOVERY; a later EV-REVOKE still reaches ST-REVOKED. Fresh CLOCK on TRUSTED with neither expiry nor stale is ACCEPTED stay.

Before ID-DEP-1 and envelopePreimageJoin activate, every APPLICABLE path that would enter ST-TRUSTED refuses; the audit refusalReason is exactly ENVELOPE-INACTIVE. outcomeBranchDiscipline.memberApplicability runs first: a recovery-typed PRESENT does not take an ordinary member's whenInactive. The reason is never PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE, INSTALL-NOT-TRUSTED, or RECOVERY-COMMIT-REFUSED for an INACTIVE envelope on an applicable named member. No canonicalization is invented.

A self-signed replacement root without a valid application of recoveryAuthoritySet refuses commit and stays ST-RECOVERY. A payload with a named authority set but no valid application to the new root refuses. A commit that identifies no old root when one exists refuses. A commit whose recovery signers do not meet the reserved recovery threshold refuses (cardinality reserved). A commit whose old-root/new-root/role binding is absent or mismatched refuses (identities reserved).
A newer revocation presented in ST-REVOKED is ACCEPTED, stays ST-REVOKED, and advances the monotonic last-known revocation.

EV-RECOVER-ABORT from ST-RECOVERY is accepted, does not publish a root, and toFunction selects the first still-true of ST-REVOKED, ST-QUORUM-LOST, ST-EXPIRED, ST-STALE-REVOCATION, else ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED. to is the declared meta-target same-or-named, not an undeclared token.

A recovery-typed complete payload from ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED stages and does not enter ST-TRUSTED, including while TRUSTED-entry is INACTIVE. An ordinary complete payload from ST-UNBOOTSTRAPPED takes the bootstrap TRUSTED-entry path (or fail-closed ENVELOPE-INACTIVE if INACTIVE). The two members are disjoint by memberApplicability, not only by guard text. There is exactly one ST-RECOVERY/PRESENT member. TRUSTED + recovery-typed PRESENT is not ENVELOPE-INACTIVE on the ordinary member; it is the recovery-unmatched fallback PAYLOAD-NOT-ADMISSIBLE if no recovery member applies.

trustPolicyShape.standing: SHAPE ONLY. No quorum, skew, or freshness NUMBER is minted (OD-112-1, OD-112-2 remain RESERVED).
requiredOnEveryTrustedEntry: bootstrapAnchorCustody: the presented root is the install-scoped accepted anchor, not a self-supplied root
roleToKeyAndDelegatedNamespace: the signer is authorized for this trust role and namespace

envelopePreimageJoin: the envelope verifies over the reserved preimage once ID-DEP-1 and this ceremony close; until then this check is DECLARED and INACTIVE and TRUSTED-entry is fail-closed (see envelopeJoinStanding). Not a satisfied conjunct while INACTIVE.
thresholdEvaluation: observed signers meet the reserved threshold parameter (value still OD-112-1)
expiryAndFutureTime: not expired; not issued unreasonably in the future (skew reserved)
revocationFreshness: last-known revocation is inside the reserved freshness floor
antiRollback: snapshot is not strictly older than the last accepted counter
trustPolicyShape.failedGuard: Stay non-TRUSTED and refuse. Do not download. Do not mutate the lock. Dependency-inactive envelope is a refusal, not a pass.
trustPolicyShape.envelopeJoinStanding: envelopePreimageJoin is DECLARED and INACTIVE until ID-DEP-1 and this row's envelope semantics activate. While INACTIVE, every transition whose target is ST-TRUSTED is unexecutable and refuses fail-closed. UNSIGNED and DIGEST_MISMATCH remain the live DR-103 half and do not substitute for this check. This artifact does not invent canonicalization.

recoveryAuthorityShape.standing: SHAPE ONLY. No quorum, participant list, or officer is minted (OD-112-1 remains RESERVED).
requiredOnRecoverCommit: oldRootIdentification: the from-root is the last accepted install-scoped root for this role, or there is no prior root because the role is UNBOOTSTRAPPED
recoveryAuthoritySet: a reserved recovery/rotation authority distinct from the replacement root's self-signature (members/threshold reserved)
recoveryAuthorityApplication: a reserved approval/application of that set over this replacement (cardinality reserved)
recoveryAuthorityThreshold: observed recovery signers meet the reserved recovery threshold (value still OD-112-1)
oldRootNewRootRoleBinding: the old-root, new-root, and role are bound as one recovery step (identities reserved)
newRootDoesNotSelfAuthorize: the replacement root is not accepted solely because it signs itself
antiRollback: the new root's counter strictly advances
recoveryAuthorityShape.failedGuard: Stay ST-RECOVERY and refuse. Do not publish. Do not download.
